Overview

Veracruz is a city in Veracruz with a population of 637,226. Mexico’s oldest port city with a lively Afro-Caribbean culture, colonial fortresses, and famous seafood. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
